summary: Enhance your skills with our Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) training course. Learn from experts and gain hands-on experience to excel in your career.
lede: RHEL administration training helps Linux professionals responsible for infrastructure configure, secure, and troubleshoot operating systems. Learners practice managing services and packages, diagnosing SELinux and firewall issues, and configuring storage and network connections. The course also introduces Ansible automation, Podman containers, and recovery planning through controlled lab exercises.
audienceIntro: This RHEL training course is designed for technical professionals who administer, support, secure, or automate Linux-based infrastructure and need intermediate to advanced operational practice.
prerequisites: You should have practical Linux command-line experience, including file navigation, permissions, processes, SSH, and basic networking. You should also be comfortable reading service logs and editing text configuration files. No programming is required for completion, although basic Bash familiarity helps with automation exercises. Advanced topics such as Ansible configuration and Podman are taught at an operational application level, not at production-grade software engineering depth. A laptop is recommended for lab access.
